resources.string: This feature is not available yet.
Official data distribution awaits source and reuse approval.
Original PDFs, images, prescriptions and records
File classification, summaries and individual export
Attachments are available within visits and individual lab results. A separate library-wide file browser is not implemented.
Separate profiles are not implemented. Existing doctor and institution details remain in visits.

Choose a visit or an individual lab result, then open Attachments to add or view encrypted files. JPEG/PNG preview is supported; PDF preview shows the first page on Android 9+. On Android 8, PDFs can be saved and backed up without an in-app preview.
Independent file organization, summaries and arbitrary file export are not implemented. Visit pack PDFs are available from a visit; complete encrypted medical backup is available above.
